serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
You: Leonardo! I need to visit my friend, call an elevator, quickly! 
You: Wait a minute, you are not Leonardo.
New concierge: No I’m not. What is the problem?
You: I want to visit my friend, he lives here.
New concierge: First name and last name of your friend?
You: W-What? I-I don’t know. Listen, I was here before.
New concierge: Please, be reasonable sir. How can I call an elevator for you if you don’t even know who you want to visit.
You: Big Daddy! That’s who I want to visit!
New concierge: *chuckles* Sorry sir, but no one with such a name lives here.
You: W-What do you mean?! Are you making fun of me?! This is urgent!
New concierge: Please calm down sir, or I will be forced to remove you from the premises.
You: What?! You piece of shit! Let me in!
New concierge: I’m calling the police. Please leave.
You: What is going on…
